events.title: Public Playtest Announcement
events.summary: We're proud to announce that our first public playtest will be available to all players for free during the last weekend of June. The playtest will run for three days and will feature the current v1.0.1-beta build of the game. We aim to give players a taste of what the full game will be like while welcoming feedback, critiques, and observations that will help us make the game even better.The playtest will be live from June 26 to June 28. Participation links will be provided soon. For more detail
